//: TEST FIXTURE — not a real deployment manifest. Supplies the andy-docs-api OAuth client to the hermetic integration-test host (CustomWebApplicationFactory wires this directory into Registrations:ManifestPaths). In production andy-docs-api is sourced from andy-docs/config/registration.json, a sibling repo that CI does not check out; this fixture stands in for it so OAuth flows can be asserted for real instead of fake-skipped. The confidential client intentionally leaves ANDY_DOCS_API_SECRET unset so DbSeeder's Development fallback yields the well-known 'andy-docs-api-secret-change-in-production' secret the tests use.

service.name: andy-docs
service.description: Test fixture manifest supplying andy-docs-api for hermetic OAuth integration tests.
